title: Code Petri Dish: simulator, instruments, pre-registered judging scripts and results for 'Mutation rate without a modifier'
description: Simulator (sim.js v0.3.6), instruments, launch and judging scripts, frozen SHA-256 files, independent recounts and result files behind every number in the manuscript Mutation rate without a modifier: copy-loop geometry couples speed to fidelity when replication can stall (MinSeo Kim and Jae-Ho Shin, 2026), together with the figure generator and its provenance list. Backgrounds are grown deterministically from their seeds by the scripts provided.
